units.text: You renew your FAFSA application because the FAFSA form applies to a single academic year, so you need to submit a new FAFSA form each year to receive financial aid for the next year.

units.reason: The contexts state that the FAFSA form applies to a single academic year and that you need to submit a new FAFSA form each year to receive aid for the next year.

units.text: Renewing is easy because it is prefilled with certain information from the prior academic year, and you just need to update any changed information and provide new income and tax details.
supporting_chunk_ids: How to Renew Your FAFSA® Application | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context says that when you log in to renew, it is prefilled with certain information from the prior academic year, and you need to provide new income and tax information and update any changed information.

units.text: Additionally, you must renew to continue meeting eligibility requirements for federal student aid.
units.reason: The context states that to continue receiving federal student aid, you need to fill out the FAFSA form each year, which implies renewing is necessary to meet eligibility requirements.
